PHILOS 2.sentiment: Students describe an enjoyable, interesting class with a passionate instructor and relatively light work. Readings can be tricky but lectures clarify them, and discussion participation matters. It is recommended as a breadth, with the final essay the hardest part.

reviews.text: Very passionate professor who knows what he's doing. Enjoyable class and interesting topics. Can manage the finals without doing the readings. Be prepared for discussion, though.
reviews.title: Great

reviews.text: This class was very fun. There was a wide variety of topics covered, and it made me realize I was more interested in philosophy than I previously thought. The professor was very passionate, and the work was relatively light. Great class for breadth, and very good if you want to learn about philosophy too.
